method: tools/lanec/cover.py: every host case of each suite run alone through build/lanec-cover/lanec-native (-O0 --coverage) and the branch arcs it takes in every linked source read with gcov -b (tools/c64_row_cover.py); the C64 rows are the cases frozen in tests/lanec_<suite>_c64.h (every case when the suite has none), and their arcs are compared with the whole host suite's; with --pool, a host arc of one suite counts as taken on the C64 when the C64 rows of any suite in the record take it (the same source line and branch in the same build)
legacy_c64_programs: the modules of these suites do not fit one C64 program with the Lane C harness; each runs on the C64 in its own milestone's program (the vice target named), checked there against its own Virtual AGC vectors, and the host arcs below are taken on the C64 only there

host_only_lines.src/lm_interbank_routines.c:9: SUPDACAL through the INTER-BANK routine reads a word of the fixed-memory rope (agc_native_program.fixed_data). Pinball calls SUPDACAL only from DSPFMEM (verb 27's fixed-memory display, in the fixed-display module), and no C64 program holding that module, the rope data and the transfer harness fits below $C000. The module runs on the C64 in vice-legacy-dsky-fixed-display; this path of the routine wrapper is checked on the host (pin-transfer, strict and ASan/UBSan) only.
